scope: Actual disposable PostgreSQL bootstrap and six distinct service logins; unrelated database/role refusal, transaction rollback, checksum/privilege/password drift, concurrent replay, API dual-stack startup and shutdown; generated standalone Next package serving real API proxy and browser sign-in; configuration mismatch rejection. Existing real account/tenant/email integration regression also runs through the refactored migration wrapper. Host-built artifact only: no Linux container build, Railway deployment, external SMTP, paid providers or social publication.
